overall_goal: Prepare an onion by peeling and finely dicing it

goals.description: Retrieve an onion and slice it in half
goals.rationale: The person gets an onion from a bag, places it on the chopping board, and cuts it in half with a knife.

goals.description: Peel the skin off both onion halves
goals.rationale: The person removes the skin from both halves of the onion, wipes off any remaining bits, and places the peeled halves on the board.

goals.description: Trim the top and bottom ends of the onion halves
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife to chop off the ends of the onion halves, wiping the blade and discarding the scraps.

goals.description: Slice the onion halves into thin strips
goals.rationale: The person turns the onion halves and slices them lengthwise into strips in preparation for dicing.

goals.description: Dice the sliced onion into fine chunks
goals.rationale: The person cuts the sliced onion in the opposite direction to create small chunks, discards the root, and chops any remaining large pieces to ensure uniform size.
